boundary_decision.rationale: The record-plane label standalone-mm is separate from subject kind. Public-health knowledge groups versioned population frames, observations, signals, decisions, programmes and evaluations under governed identities, making aggregate more defensible than entity or event.

decisions.rationale: The model owns cohort and population aggregates only. Person identifiers, clinical narratives and immunization events remain in source systems and cross the boundary only through minimum authorized aggregates or evidence references.

decisions.concept: Previous B14 COMPOSE relation to personal health
decisions.rationale: Composition would imply importing or owning person-health semantics. Typed aggregate contribution references better preserve custody and disclosure boundaries.
Removed direct identifiers do not eliminate small-cell, rare-combination, fine geography-time, repeated-release or linkage risk, so every projection requires a disclosure-risk decision.
Surveillance case definitions exist for consistent classification and counting and must not be used as clinical diagnosis or treatment rules.

decisions.disposition: accepted as separate states and objects
decisions.rationale: An anomaly or report creates a signal requiring assessment, while an outbreak requires a pinned definition, threshold, evidence and authorized declaration.
Counts, rates, ratios, risks, proportions and modelled estimates remain distinct and carry population, period, numerator, denominator, unit, method, uncertainty and revision status.
Separating these classes prevents agents from presenting model output as observed fact or a policy scenario as an expected outcome.
Intervention definition, legal authority, implementation facts and causal effect estimates have different evidence and authority and cannot be inferred from temporal association alone.
FHIR MeasureReport and Immunization are useful exchange references, but alignment never authorizes person-compartment data to enter the population model.
The applicable IHR text, effective date, State Party position and decision authority must be pinned rather than assuming one universal notification rule.
Physical properties belong to referenced people, organisms, specimens, products, facilities and places; this model owns their permitted population-level context and measurements.
Every finding asks for cohort-place-time scope, source and method, uncertainty, and revision or disclosure controls. Repeated structure is machine-friendly but needs later specialist profile review.
